The SKYLINE ulcerative colitis platform continues to enroll ahead of schedule, with Part A readouts to begin in Q2 2026.

**SKYWAY Trial Enrollment Completion (June 3)**

On June 3, 2026, Spyre announced the completion of enrollment for all sub-studies in the SKYWAY basket trial of SPY072 (anti-TL1A) in rheumatic diseases. The completion of enrollment across all SKYWAY sub-studies in less than nine months underscores the substantial unmet need among the more than three million U.S. patients living with RA, PsA, and axSpA and high enthusiasm for SPY072 as a potential first- and best-in-class anti-TL1A therapy in rheumatic diseases. The company reiterates Phase 2 efficacy readouts in Q3–Q4 2026 and is presenting supportive preclinical data at EULAR 2026.

**SKYLINE Trial Results (June 15)**

On June 15, 2026, Spyre announced promising results from the 12-week induction phase of its Phase 2 SKYLINE trial, focusing on SPY002, a novel anti-TL1A treatment for individuals with moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. The trial's initial findings revealed a remarkable 10.7-point decrease in the RHI score, alongside notable rates of clinical remission and endoscopic improvement.

**Investor Conference Participation**

Pipeline targets α4β7 (SPY001), TL1A (SPY002 / SPY072), and IL-23 (SPY003). Lead programs are in the Phase 2 SKYLINE (ulcerative colitis) and SKYWAY (rheumatic) platform trials.

**Next known catalyst(s) + timing**
- SPY003 (IL-23) Part A induction UC data — expected Q3 2026.
- SKYWAY (SPY072, anti-TL1A in RA/PsA/axSpA) Phase 2 efficacy readouts — Q3–Q4 2026; topline RA readout accelerated to Q3 2026. Enrollment across all SKYWAY sub-studies completed June 3, 2026.

**What drove the stock over the last ~2 weeks (early–mid June 2026)**
- Primary driver: June 15, 2026 — positive SPY002 (anti-TL1A) Phase 2 SKYLINE 12-week induction UC data. Hit primary endpoint: 10.7-point RHI reduction (p<0.0001); 33% clinical remission (modified Mayo), 42% endoscopic improvement — characterized by the company as among the highest reported in UC. Stock rose ~7.5% on the print.
- Secondary support: June 3 SKYWAY full-enrollment completion (ahead of schedule, <9 months); EULAR 2026 preclinical presentation; conference appearances (Jefferies June 3, Goldman Sachs June 8).
- Sell-side response: BTIG raised PT to $112 (from $98); Wedbush raised to $100 (from $80, June 16); a Buy/$103 PT reaffirmed June 15. Consensus PT roughly $94–$112 range.

**Thesis: did it materially improve, or just price?**
- Materially improved. SPY002 is the second positive Phase 2 UC readout in the platform (after SPY001 on April 13: 9.2-pt RHI, p<0.0001, 40% remission/51% endoscopic improvement). Two independent mechanisms now de-risked in the same indication validates the long-acting-antibody platform thesis, not just sentiment. This is fundamental, not drift.
